title: virtual-fly: a connectome-initialized, plastic virtual Drosophila in closed loop
description: virtual-fly starts from the released adult male Drosophila MaleCNS connectome and evolves neural activity, neuromodulation, and local synaptic plasticity in closed loop with a FlyBody/MuJoCo body and environment. Canonical experiment v1 provides a pinned provenance-tracked reference run and an end-to-end reproducer. The short canonical run demonstrates changes to stored CNS weights under the current local-plasticity semantics; it does not establish categorical behavioral improvement, generalization, or long-term learning stability.
